title: Oscar and the Cover
author: Vesper Zhou
blurb: Emrys Ishikawa, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
